title: The Art of the Smile
subtitle: Sami & Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! ✨🦷

Sami is an enthusiastic dentist: 'A perfect smile? Ceramic veneers are the solution!' Mina, an aesthetics expert, corrects him: 'Not so fast, Sami! Aesthetics is much more than just veneers.'

Between a patient with tetracycline stains, an asymmetrical smile, a gummy smile, or tooth wear, aesthetics is a true art.

A wrong shade choice, inadequate preparation, and the smile looks artificial. Rigorous analysis, meticulous planning, and the patient regains a natural and harmonious smile.

Smile harmony, patient confidence, and the art of aesthetics rest on YOUR shoulders.
